name: ARV03: Treatment Coverage Analysis
description: Analysis of drug coverage periods and treatment gaps
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "cbde3fc4-833a-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_patients, AVG(days_on_drugs) AS avg_days FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order WHERE is_active_on_art = 1", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "total_patients", "type": "number", "label": "Total Patients"}], "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
WITH active_art_base AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order
        WHERE is_active_on_art = 1
          AND coverage_start_date <= :endDate
          AND (coverage_end_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY OR coverage_end_date IS NULL)
        UNION
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_return_date
        WHERE return_date >= :endDate - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND return_date <= :endDate
    ) as potential_active
    WHERE client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT client_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
        WHERE transfer_out_date IS NOT NULL AND transfer_out_date <= :endDate
    )
    AND client_id NOT IN (
        SELECT person_id FROM person
        WHERE dead = 1 AND death_date <= :endDate
    )
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
    SUM(CASE WHEN coverage_end_date >= CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_coverage,
    SUM(CASE WHEN coverage_end_date < CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS coverage_expired,
    ROUND(AVG(days_on_drugs), 1) AS avg_days_on_drugs,
    ROUND(MAX(days_on_drugs), 1) AS max_days_on_drugs
FROM active_art_base base
INNER JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_arv_order arv ON base.client_id = arv.client_id
